wiki.title: Wylie Galt
wiki.extract: Errol Wylie Galt (born 1984) is an American politician in the Montana Senate. He served as the Speaker of the Montana House of Representatives. As a Republican member of the Montana House of Representatives, he represented the 30th district from 2017 until he was term limited in 2023. He previously served in the Montana House of Representatives from the 83rd district from 2013 to 2015.
